verdict_rationale: Site with solar installation visible in imagery near W.A. Parish 345kV corridor; approved-for-sync Jan 2022 confirms physical infrastructure exists; chronic 19-drift COD pattern and absence from EIA 860M after 4.5 years signal prolonged commissioning stall, not a paper project

ownership.spv: Buffalo Creek, LLC (presumed; unverified — TX SOS behind paywall, PUCT Interchange 402, no web presence found)
ownership.developer: unknown — not determined (no web presence, no Ch.313/JETI found, no press release found)

site.method: imagery — solar array visible in Sentinel-2 June 2021 and June 2026 chips centered ~29.33°N 95.84°W; location consistent with W.A. Parish 345kV corridor heading SW from Parish substation (29.4808, -95.6242); area NOT matching any EIA 860M registered plant in Fort Bend County
site.confidence: low-medium — site is a candidate; could overlap with Fighting Jays Solar (EIA: 29.358, -95.746) or an unregistered portion; gmaps rate-limited throughout, no parcel record obtained
site.cross_checks: W.A. Parish 345kV substation at 29.4808, -95.6242 (OSM confirmed); candidate location ~12 km SW on 345kV line; Fighting Jays (29.358, -95.746) separate chip showed no solar array in June 2026; installation visible at ~29.32-29.35N 95.82-95.84W not in EIA 860M

project_area.source: not determined — PUCT IA inaccessible (402), Ch.313/JETI not found, CAD JS-gated

construction.first_activity_seen: 2021-06 (solar array rows visible with access road grid in Sentinel-2 chip)
construction.latest_observation: 2026-06 (dark module rows still present; consistent operating installation)
construction.notes: ERCOT milestone: approved-for-sync 2022-01-06 confirms physical grid connection. Not in EIA 860M as of May 2026 (neither Operating nor Planned) — plant installed but not commercially registered.

abatement.notes: Ch.313 2023 supplemental data PDF: no Fort Bend County entries. JETI current agreements: no solar or Fort Bend County entries. No abatement found.

eia860m.source: EIA Form 860M May 2026 download checked — Buffalo Creek not present in either sheet. Fort Bend solar plants confirmed: Cutlass Solar 1 (110.9 MW 2022), Cutlass Solar II (202.8 MW 2024), Fighting Jays (227.5 MW 2022), Fort Bend Solar LLC/Acciona (240 MW 2023).

cod_assessment.rationale: 19 drifts over 5 years with last 4 each 1-3 months apart; approved-for-sync Jan 2022 but no commercial operation 4.5 years later is highly anomalous; installation appears physically present but something prevents commercial operation (grid studies, equipment, contractual, or regulatory); 2026-08-31 COD is 6 weeks away with no construction completion reported and not in EIA 860M — implausible on current evidence; even if COD achieved by year-end 2026, high probability of further drift given pattern
